target.statement: Finite-sample efficiency of the reweighted MMCD estimators (ratio of KL divergence of MLE to MMCD) exceeding ~90% for a small (p,q) setting such as (5,20) at moderate n, as shown in the efficiency simulation study
target.table_ref: Section 6, Finite-sample efficiency (Figures 2-4 / simulation results; no numbered table)
target.dataset: Synthetic matrix-normal samples generated in the paper's simulation (p,q)=(5,20), n in {20,50,100,300,1000}, Sigma_row=Sigma_rnd, Sigma_col=Sigma_mix(0.7), 100 repetitions)

compute.basis: No code link is given in the PDF (code only mentioned as being in the supplement), so the MMCD algorithm (elemental subsets, flip-flop MLE, C-steps, reweighting) must be reimplemented from the pseudo-code; the simulation itself is small (p=5,q=20,n<=1000, 100 reps) and CPU-only, but reimplementation plus 100-rep runs across several n values takes a few hours.
